Diary of an Angry Primeape | POKÉTOON Short
Summer vacation brings an amazing adventure for a young Trainer and his friend Primeape! Noticing that Primeape is angry all the time, the boy begins an experiment to find out what—if anything—will help it calm down. In his observation journal, he records failure after failure, but he’s determined to keep trying until he finds an answer. Could there be a big breakthrough in store for the boy and Primeape as their summer continues?
